content.title: Test tomorrow?
content.subtitle: Your preparation is done. Now just avoid small mistakes.

steps.title: Check your ID
steps.detail: Take the same ID you used to register. Match the spelling of your name too.

steps.title: Check the route
steps.detail: See today how long it takes to reach the centre. Leave early tomorrow.

steps.title: Sleep well
steps.detail: Studying all night won't teach you anything new. A fresh mind works better.

steps.title: Light revision
steps.detail: Don't open a new topic. Go over your notes and old mistakes.
steps.tip: Read the Failure Patterns in the IELTS kit once.

steps.title: Pack your bag at night
steps.detail: ID, confirmation email and water. Carry only what is allowed. It saves the morning rush.

content.saveLine: it will help before your test.

caption:
IELTS, TOEFL or GRE tomorrow? Do these 5 things today and tomorrow will feel easier 👇

1. Check your ID
2. Check the route
3. Sleep well
4. Light revision
5. Pack your bag at night

Save this 📌 and send it to a friend who needs it.
